results.rationale: Consistency: The white background remains, but the small silver scissors have been shrunk and moved down-left, and an additional central pair has appeared. Instruction: The large green-handled scissors remain large; the expected result is that same pair reduced to the small silver pair’s size. No requested reduction is achieved. Quality: Structure and artifact checks fail: the central scissors have a broken handle ring and collide with adjoining blade/handle geometry; the large scissors and white surface remain recognizable, with plausible shading. Knowledge is not applicable.

Consistency: The white field and green-handled pair’s identity and diagonal arrangement are retained; the non-target silver scissors are visibly enlarged/reshaped and shifted left. Instruction: The green pair still spans far more of the image than the silver pair. A successful edit would reduce the green pair to the silver pair’s size; that change is absent. Quality: Structure, naturalness, artifact absence and texture fidelity are satisfactory: both scissors have coherent rings, blades and pivots with plausible contact shadows. Moderate softness does not impair recognition. Knowledge is not applicable.

Quality: Structure, naturalness, artifact absence and surface texture are satisfactory; the two closed scissors have coherent outlines, connected handles and believable shadows.
